hero.title: It runs on a computer you can buy at a shop
hero.lede: Crewline reads your graphics card and memory, recommends a size and downloads what it needs in one click.

jobs.title: What each model does
jobs.lede: You can change any of these in Settings. These are the ones the Best tier used on the test day.

oneCard.title: One graphics card did all of it
oneCard.lede: The test day ran on an RTX 5070 with 12 GB. Smaller tiers work on any PC, more slowly.

image.alt: A graphics card installed inside a PC.

youChoose.title: You choose
lede: Settings lists alternatives for each job, including Gemma 4, gpt-oss, Nemotron, Whisper, GLM-OCR and Qwen3-TTS. They download once, through llama.cpp and whisper.cpp.

image.alt: The Models screen recommending the Best tier.
